Combined Predictor Results Table (Flextable)

create_regression_combined_table.Rd

Creates a flextable with one row per predictor showing variable type, bivariate correlation r (with p), regression weight b (with p), and bivariate/multivariate interpretation category (a-d).

Usage

create_regression_combined_table(reg_results_list, KEY = TRUE)

Arguments

reg_results_list

Output from regression_answers().

KEY

Logical. If TRUE (default), fill with computed values. If FALSE, create a blank template (column widths are preserved).

Value

A flextable object.

Examples

data(superman)
sm <- superman[!is.na(superman$rt_critics_score) &
                    !is.na(superman$rt_audience_score), ]
result <- regression_answers(
  data = sm,
  criterion = "rt_critics_score",
  quant_predictors = c("clark_height_in", "rt_audience_score"),
  quant_labels = c("Height", "Audience"),
  criterion_label = "Critics Score"
)
create_regression_combined_table(result, KEY = TRUE)
